heading: Inks, Colors & Shirts
items: Provide a color comp/proof in CMYK mode showing final print appearance
Specify ink and shirt colors clearly
Use Spot Colors (including White and Black) from our stock inks or the Pantone Coated guide
Ink colors tend to shift on colored shirts
Some colors require underlays on dark garments
Avoid the Multiply blending mode for translucent effects
Schedule an ink drawdown to proof final color combinations
